label: positive

blockers.detail: Commit 1e80a47 adds INI_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR option (18 lines of conditional code with custom ini_malloc/ini_free/ini_realloc). When enabled, users can provide custom memory allocators. However, OSS-Fuzz's build.sh does NOT compile with -DINI_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR=1, so all custom allocator code paths (18 lines in ini.c) have 0% coverage. The library unit tests test this feature, but fuzzing does not.

rationale.zh: inih添加了INI_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR配置选项，允许用户提供自定义内存分配器（ini_malloc/ini_free/ini_realloc）。这是一个编译时配置选项，添加了18行条件编译代码。但是OSS-Fuzz的build.sh没有定义这个选项，导致所有自定义分配器的代码路径完全未被测试，覆盖率0%。虽然库自己的单元测试测试了这个功能，但fuzzing测试没有。这是典型的配置类退化：新增的编译选项未在fuzzing构建中启用。属于隐式configuration类退化。
rationale.en: inih added INI_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR configuration option allowing users to provide custom memory allocators (ini_malloc/ini_free/ini_realloc). This is a compile-time configuration option adding 18 lines of conditional code. However, OSS-Fuzz's build.sh does NOT define this option, causing all custom allocator code paths to be completely untested with 0% coverage. While the library's own unit tests test this feature, fuzzing does not. This is a典型 configuration degradation: newly added compilation option not enabled in fuzzing build. Silent configuration degradation.
